translation: Wang was a Confucian; although his way of medicine did not reach Sun Simiao, yet in taking the formulas of the various schools and obtaining their essentials, he is also of the class of Cui and Meng Shen. Moreover, the ancients such as Zhang Zhongjing, the 《Jiyan》 (Collected Proofs), and the 《Duanju Fang》 (Short and Complete Formulas) were the most famous schools, but many are now lost and scattered, and in the formulas one cannot distinguish them clearly. Wang arranged them in order, giving each a title and name, so that later learners all know their origin; this is his strength. He also said that needling can kill the living but cannot raise the dead, and that its method has long been lost, so he took moxibustion and did not take needling; this is also a defect of the physician's family.
